categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Deye Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the photovoltaic (PV) inverter industry and home appliances sector. Its main product lines include PV inverters (storage inverters, string inverters, microgrid inverters), energy storage battery packs, dehumidifiers, and heat exchangers. The company also engages in manufacturing and sales of refrigeration equipment, air purification devices, and electronic intelligent controllers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as three-level SVPWM drive technology and single-phase/three-phase phase-locked loop technology to enhance inverter efficiency and stability. It employs digitalized and automated production methods, integrating CRM, SRM, ERP, MOM, APS, PLM, and global after-sales systems to manage the full product lifecycle. The company also adopts silicon carbide solutions for storage inverters to reduce size and optimize material costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Deye serves residential and small to medium commercial customers in the renewable energy sector, particularly PV system users requiring inverters and energy storage solutions. It also caters to consumers and businesses in the home appliance market, especially for dehumidifiers and heat exchangers. Key export markets include South Africa, Germany, Brazil, and India, with significant domestic sales in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province. It has expanded its market presence internationally with subsidiaries and sales in South Africa, Germany, Brazil, India, Singapore, Australia, and Japan. It has established after-sales service points in key overseas markets and participates in global exhibitions to enhance brand recognition.
categories.supply_chain_position: Deye operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of photovoltaic inverters, energy storage systems, and home appliances. It sources raw materials and components such as electronic parts, copper tubes, aluminum foil, and compressors, and sells finished products to distributors, end-users, and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in PV inverter technology, expanding power ranges and improving conversion efficiency. It invests heavily in R&D to develop new products like balcony micro-storage inverters and 100KW storage PCS series. Digital transformation and automation in production are strategic priorities, alongside talent acquisition and retention through equity incentives. The company aims to maintain industry-leading core technologies and expand its product matrix.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of photovoltaic inverters, energy storage battery packs, dehumidifiers, and heat exchangers. Sales channels include direct sales, online platforms, distributors, and international exports. The company also earns income from government subsidies and financial investments such as bank wealth management products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Deye is positioned as a leading player in the PV inverter industry with a comprehensive product portfolio covering storage, string, and microinverters. It competes globally with other inverter manufacturers by leveraging technological innovation and differentiated products. The company holds a strong market position in residential storage inverters and maintains competitive advantages through continuous R&D and market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Deye reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.48 billion, a 25.59% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.79 billion, up 18.03%. Total assets reached RMB 10.82 billion, growing 27.15%, with equity of RMB 5.23 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding product lines and international market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Deye emphasizes high efficiency, safety, and reliability in its inverter products, with patented technologies enhancing conversion efficiency and grid stability. Its integrated energy storage solutions offer high integration, safety, and long cycle life. The company differentiates itself through a broad product matrix, digitalized manufacturing, and strong after-sales service networks, catering to diverse customer needs in renewable energy and home appliances.
